slides.title: Enterprise AI Operating Review
slides.subtitle: Global Scalability, Enterprise NRR Acceleration & Fiscal 2027 Capital Strategy
slides.speaker_notes: Welcome members of the board. Today we review our full-year operational execution, financial acceleration, and capital allocation for fiscal 2027.

slides.title: Core Financial & Operational Milestones
slides.subtitle: Sustained top-decile unit economics across 4 enterprise operating dimensions
slides.speaker_notes: Our ARR expanded 118 percent year-over-year to 48.5 million dollars, driven by enterprise net retention exceeding 96 percent. Unit economics continue to demonstrate top-tier capital efficiency.

slides.title: Four-Phase Enterprise Modernization Rollout
slides.subtitle: De-risked execution timeline aligned with tier-1 banking compliance milestones

steps: SOC2 Type II & FedRAMP Compliance Verification

slides.speaker_notes: Phase one and two compliance certifications were completed on schedule. Tier-one European banking implementations went live in Q3 with zero downtime.

slides.title: Tier-1 Enterprise Expansion Acceleration
slides.subtitle: Rapid enterprise adoption across global financial services institutions
slides.speaker_notes: Enterprise tier-one account volume grew 340 percent year-over-year, validating product-market fit across financial services and healthcare.

slides.title: Executive Perspective

content_blocks.quote: Autonomous intelligence is no longer an experimental R&D initiative; it is now the operational backbone of modern financial infrastructure.
content_blocks.attribution: — Chief Information Officer, Global Banking Consortium

slides.speaker_notes: This customer endorsement summarizes the strategic posture: our software has graduated from pilot experiments to mission-critical infrastructure.

slides.title: FY2027 Capital Deployment Strategy
slides.subtitle: Disciplined reinvestment prioritized across core R&D and global market coverage

right_items: Dedicated EMEA & APAC enterprise sales teams

slides.speaker_notes: We recommend committing 55 percent of incoming capital to R&D while dedicating 45 percent to customer success pods and sustaining an 18-month cash reserve.
